Inflam of the dermis & epidermis from direct contact b/n a substance & the surface of the skin
▪︎soaps, detergents, organic solvents; limited to sites of direct contact
, poison ivy, poison oak, topical abx (bacitracin, neomycin), anesthetics, adhesive tape, cosmetics, hair dyes; may extend beyond contact sites
▪︎allergic: intensely pruritic macules/papules, weeping vesicles, crusted lesions; ± edema/warmth; severe → bullae
▪︎irritant: erythematous, scaly, burning/stinging lesions; vesicles ⇣common vs allergic
▪︎decrescendo: irritant ⊕ · allergic ⊖; histo: irritant spongiosis + keratinocyte necrosis vs allergic spongiosis
▪︎excoriations/trauma ⇡risk impetigo/cellulitis; Gram stain + cx to r/o infect; US/CT if abscess suspected
▪︎poison ivy/oak: wash w/ soap + H2O w/in 30 min; weeping → cleanse + wet-to-dry dressings (calamine/zinc oxide between); emollients
